name: akeno-network
description: AKENO NETWORK - a private, self-hosted gaming community platform.

scripts.client:build: clients/ps5/scripts/fetch-deps.sh && cmake -S clients/ps5 -B clients/ps5/build-asan -DAKENO_SANITIZE=ON -DAKENO_REQUIRE_MBEDTLS=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build clients/ps5/build-asan -j
scripts.test:client: pnpm build && pnpm client:build && clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno_unit_tests && clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno_unit_tests_mbedtls && node clients/ps5/tests/integration/run.mjs clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno-cli && node clients/ps5/tests/integration/run.mjs clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno-cli-mbedtls --app clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno-app --audiolab clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno-app-audiolab --capturediag clients/ps5/build-asan/akeno-app-capturediag
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
